method.automated: Actions workload ancestry-audit: exact archive, inventory and retained-ledger match to the D source lock, then for every retained member origin markers, project and external-origin tokens and exact 12-line whitespace-normalized windows (>=240 bytes) shared across families.
method.leads: origin_leads.generate derives every review lead with a stable ID: each cross-project token per (family, path), each provenance marker (based on, derived from, copied or taken from, adapted, generated, public domain) and each notice naming another roster family's principal author. Copyright lines naming only the family's own authors are covered by the Slice D license review. Every lead was read before any candidate, scorer or encoder output existed and carries exactly one disposition below; unresolved is derived from the dispositions.
method.limits: Exact text only: modified/renamed/nonconsecutive copies can be missed. Shared license/algorithm constants can produce false ancestry leads. Algorithmic derivation without shared text is not treated as shared payload.

positive_control.reading: The detector finds text shared between releases of every family, so cross-family zero counts are not a detector failure. The control covers near-unchanged copies only; it does not measure false negatives for modified or reformatted shared code.
